generations.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / YouTube channel brand illustration.
Create a finished opaque channel banner for "Paspla Studio". Edit Image 1 into the final artwork and PRESERVE ITS EXACT CANVAS SIZE 2560x1440 pixels.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is a structural layout canvas ONLY. Its rectangle and blobs mark positions, not desired shapes or a decorative frame. Remove every guide line/blob in the final.
Image 2 is the user's PRIMARY ART DIRECTION and character-family reference. Faithfully match its delicate uneven brown pencil contours, quiet translucent watercolor/crayon wash, softly textured cream paper, muted sage greens, butter yellow, dusty pink, light orange. Match the rabbit/cat/bird designs from this image. Do not intensify saturation or thicken outlines.
Image 3 is the canonical main bear identity reference. Preserve this pale-yellow bear's original face, ears, short body/limbs and coral-red beret, but render its line weight and shading in the light handmade style of Image 2. No cheek blush, no generic teddy redesign. The red beret remains its signature.

BANNER COMPOSITION AND CROP SAFETY:
This is a full 2560x1440 YouTube banner which is cropped vertically on phones.
ALL important lettering AND the complete primary characters must lie INSIDE x=530..2030 and y=540..900. Treat that as the non-negotiable central safe band.
- Bear at left of this band, approx x=760 center, y=730 center, total height about 300 pixels including hat. Gently holds an open little picture book. Whole bear including hat and feet inside the band.
- Small soft pink rabbit beside the bear, approx x=960 center, y=770 center, total height about 210 pixels including ears, quietly looking at a little map. Same rabbit identity as Image 2.
- Brand title centered-right, x=1100..1770, y=625..800: EXACT TEXT "Paspla Studio". One line of clean rounded dark-warm-brown hand-lettering, highly legible on cream paper, with enough clear space. Spell exactly P a s p l a [space] S t u d i o. No alternate spelling. Do not place text in a sign, frame, badge or border.
- Small ginger tabby cat at far right of the band, approx x=1900 center, y=730 center, total height about 300 pixels. Same cream-orange cat, forehead/cheek stripes, round face and green backpack as Image 2. One tiny yellow bird may stand near its feet.
- Keep safe-band objects comfortably separate; no body, ear, hat, word or letter crosses outside y540..900.

OUTER ART:
A gentle meadow/picnic storybook world spreads naturally across the entire canvas: distant sage bushes, a winding pale path, a few cream/yellow daisies, light foliage near far left and right corners, tree canopy high near an edge, very pale spacious sky/paper above. Draw with the restrained handmade touch of Image 2. Peripheral landscape outside the safe band is decorative and may be cropped away.
Keep lots of air around the title. The entire image is an opaque warm-cream illustration, not a transparent cutout, not black. No rectangular safe-area outline, no panels, no borders, no shadows around the file.

AVOID:
No glossy 3D, no bright cyan/lime neon lawn from earlier game mockups, no thick vector outline, no giant sparkles, no heavy glow, no photorealism, no additional mascots, no extra text or slogan, no numerals, no YouTube logo, no watermark, no layout guides. Do not turn the title into a new invented channel name.
Output ONLY the completed banner image at 2560x1440.

export_policy: Creative drawing/layout changes use built-in image_gen. FFmpeg performs final dimensional resampling, encoding and QA crop/preview exports. Generated native resolutions are retained; export sizes do not imply native generated detail.

exports.aspect_ratio_change: Native dimensions are recorded per file. Landscape masters are resampled to exact 16:9; the aspect-ratio adjustment is below 0.2%.
exports.circle_preview: 98x98 preview only; centered circular alpha mask, final upload icon remains square
